label: Logical falsity, by Constructive-derivation
meaning: Take the existing false-content token and situation, apply the qualified report premise there, and transport report truth to content truth through the tested equivalence, contradicting that same token’s false content. Three single-deletion models show inclusion-minimality in this fixed semantics, not minimum cardinality across other vocabularies. The misleading replacement of external content by a correct internal report fails; neither mental/physical identity nor physical realization is a premise of this core.
